lines.text: A father urges his sons to listen, and recalls how his own father taught him as a boy.
His father says wisdom is supreme and will set a crown of thorns on whoever embraces her.
The father promises many years of life and straight paths, and tells his son to hold on to instruction.
The father warns his son to avoid the wicked, who eat the bread of idleness and drink the wine of violence.
The righteous path shines brighter until midday, and the father says to guard your heart and turn from evil.
